body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Powermat showed off its latest wireless charging solutions for mobile phones at CES 2010. According to the company, the mobile phones receive power via wireless charging when the phone or the battery itself is placed onto a Powermat charger.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
